Name: Dottore - NPC (Genshin Impact)Traditional Chinese translation
Author: ww5598733
Description:
This is a new NPC Dottore created by CometBoba. Only Traditional Chinese translation files are provided here. Please go to the original file URL to download and overwrite it before downloading.

Original file: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18341

Warning here: this is a villain from Genshin Impact, a genius madman who can do human experiments. If you have any doubts, please do not download it at will, although the author does not describe these things in any detail.

And this module is not compatible with RSV (it will conflict with the export), but there is no problem with SVE, and this translation file only modifies and translates the original version, and does not translate the RSV version next to Linus' tent. This translation document has been edited by computer. If there are any errors, please feel free to ask questions. Thank you very much.

(The above English translation comes from Google Translate)
